verses.geez: ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ያመጽእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መጥባሕተ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ወዓቢየ፡ ወጽኑዓ፡ ላዕለ፡ ከይሲ፡ ወላዕለ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ዘይጐይይ፡ ኀበ፡ ከይሲ፡ ወአርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ዘየአኪ፤ ወይቀትሎ፡ ለከይሲ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ባሕር።
verses.translation: In that day God shall bring his holy and great and strong sword upon the dragon, even the serpent that flees, upon the dragon, the crooked serpent: he shall destroy the dragon.

translations.lxx: In that day God shall bring his holy and great and strong sword upon the dragon, even the serpent that flees, upon the dragon, the crooked serpent: he shall destroy the dragon.
translations.kjv: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
translations.ron: În ziua aceea Domnul se va năpusti cu sabia Sa grea, mare şi puternică, asupra leviatanului, a şarpelui care fuge, asupra leviatanului, a şarpelui încolăcit, şi va omorî balaurul cel din Nil.

verses.geez: ውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ዐፀደ፡ ወይን፡ ሠናይ፡ ወመፍትው፡ ዘእምትካት፡ ዘዚአሃ።
verses.translation: In that day there shall be a fair vineyard, and a desire to commence a song concerning it.

translations.lxx: In that day there shall be a fair vineyard, and a desire to commence a song concerning it.
translations.kjv: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
translations.ron: Şi se va zice în ziua aceea: "Vie cu vin bun, cântă!

verses.geez: አነ፡ ሀገር፡ ጽንዕት፤ አሐተ፡ ሀገረ፡ ይጸብኡ፡ ወከንቶ፡ አስተይክዋ፤ ሌሊተ፡ ትሠገር፡ ወመዓልተ፡ ይወድቅ፡ አረፍታ፤ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያነሥኣ።
verses.translation: I am a strong city, a city in a siege: in vain shall I water it; for it shall be taken by night, and by day the wall shall fall.

translations.lxx: I am a strong city, a city in a siege: in vain shall I water it; for it shall be taken by night, and by day the wall shall fall.
translations.kjv: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
translations.ron: Eu, Domnul, sunt străjerul ei, în fiecare clipă Eu o ud, ca frunzele ei să nu cadă. Zi şi noapte Eu o păzesc;

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይሠይመኒ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ህለት፡ በገዳም፤ በእንተ፡ ዛቲ፡ ጸብእቄዕክዋ።
verses.translation: There is no woman that has not taken hold of it; who will set me to watch stubble in the field? because of this enemy I have set her aside; therefore on this account the Lord has done all that he appointed.

translations.lxx: There is no woman that has not taken hold of it; who will set me to watch stubble in the field? because of this enemy I have set her aside; therefore on this account the Lord has done all that he appointed.
translations.kjv: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
translations.ron: Nu sunt mâniat de fel pe ea. Dar dacă voi găsi mărăcini şi spini, voi porni război împotriva lor şi-i voi arde pe toţi.

verses.geez: ወአውየዉ፡ እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ወንግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ሰላመ።
verses.translation: I am burnt up; they that dwell in her shall cry, Let us make peace with him, let us make peace,

translations.lxx: I am burnt up; they that dwell in her shall cry, Let us make peace with him, let us make peace,
translations.kjv: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
translations.ron: Sau mai bine să caute ocrotirea Mea şi cu Mine să facă pace, şi cu Mine să fie în pace!...".

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ እስመ፡ ይሠርጽ፡ ወይፈሪ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወእስራኤል፡ ወይመልእ፡ ዓለመ፡ ፍሬሁ።
verses.translation: they that are coming are the children of Jacob. Israel shall bud and blossom, and the world shall be filled with his fruit.

translations.lxx: they that are coming are the children of Jacob. Israel shall bud and blossom, and the world shall be filled with his fruit.
translations.kjv: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
translations.ron: Dar într-o zi Iacov va prinde rădăcini, Israel va înflori, va rodi şi cu roadele sale lumea o va umple.

verses.geez: ኢይትቀሠፍ፡ ዳእሙ፡ በከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቀሠፈ፤ ወበከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቀተለ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይትቀተል።
verses.translation: Shall he himself be thus smitten, even as he smote? and as he slew, shall he be thus slain?

translations.lxx: Shall he himself be thus smitten, even as he smote? and as he slew, shall he be thus slain?
translations.kjv: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
translations.ron: L-a lovit oare Domnul cum l-au lovit cei ce l-au lovit, sau i-a omorât El cum au făcut ucigaşii lui?

verses.translation: Fighting and reproaching he will dismiss them; didst thou not meditate with a harsh spirit, to slay them with a wrathful spirit?

translations.lxx: Fighting and reproaching he will dismiss them; didst thou not meditate with a harsh spirit, to slay them with a wrathful spirit?
translations.kjv: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
translations.ron: Cu izgonire, cu robie pedepsitu-i-a şi i-a măturat cu suflarea Lui năprasnică de vânt de răsărit.

verses.geez: ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይሠዐር፡ ኃጢአቱ፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ በረከቱ፡ አመ፡ አእተትኩ፡ ኃጢአቶ፣፡ አመ፡ አንበሩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እበኒሆሙ፡ ውቁረ፡ ከመ፡ ግብስስ፡ ድቁቅ።
verses.translation: Therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be taken away; and this is his blessing, when I shall have taken away his sin; when they shall have broken to pieces all the stones of the altars as fine dust, and their trees shall not remain, and their idols shall be cut off, as a thicket afar off.

translations.lxx: Therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be taken away; and this is his blessing, when I shall have taken away his sin; when they shall have broken to pieces all the stones of the altars as fine dust, and their trees shall not remain, and their idols shall be cut off, as a thicket afar off.
translations.kjv: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
translations.ron: Aşa a fost ispăşită fărădelegea lui Iacov, şi acesta este rodul iertării păcatului său. El a sfărâmat în bucăţi toate pietrele jertfelnicului, ca nişte pietre de var; dumbrăvile Astartei şi stâlpii soarelui nu se vor mai ridica.

verses.geez: ማኅደረ፡ መራዕይ፡ ያአትትዎ፡ ከመ፡ መርዔት፡ ዘኀደግዎ፣፡ ጕንዱየ፡ ዕለተ፡ ይትረዐይ፡ ወየዐርፍ፡ ህየ።
verses.translation: The flock that dwelt there shall be left, as a deserted flock; and the ground shall be for a long time for pasture, and there shall flocks lie down to rest.

translations.lxx: The flock that dwelt there shall be left, as a deserted flock; and the ground shall be for a long time for pasture, and there shall flocks lie down to rest.
translations.kjv: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
translations.ron: Cetatea cea întărită a rămas singură, un loc părăsit şi neumblat ca un pustiu. Acolo paşte viţelul, în ea îşi are sălaşul şi îi mănâncă mlădiţele.

verses.geez: ወጕንዱየ፡ ይየብስ፡ ወኢይትረከብ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሐመልማል።
verses.translation: And after a time there shall be in it no green thing because of the grass being parched. Come hither, ye women that come from a sight; for it is a people of no understanding; therefore he that made them shall have no pity upon them, and he that formed them shall have no mercy upon them.

translations.lxx: And after a time there shall be in it no green thing because of the grass being parched. Come hither, ye women that come from a sight; for it is a people of no understanding; therefore he that made them shall have no pity upon them, and he that formed them shall have no mercy upon them.
translations.kjv: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
translations.ron: Când crengile se usucă, se rup şi cad, femeile vin şi le dau foc. Acesta este un popor fără de minte şi nici Ziditorul lui nu Se milostiveşte de el şi nici Făcătorul lui nu are milă de el.

verses.geez: ወውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ የሐጽር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምናሕበ፡ ፈለግ፡ እስከ፡ ሪኖንቆርሮን።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day that God shall fence men off from the channel of the river as far as Rhinocorura; but do ye gather one by one the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass in that day that God shall fence men off from the channel of the river as far as Rhinocorura; but do ye gather one by one the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi în ziua aceea, Domnul va aduna roade de la Eufrat şi până la râul Egiptului; şi voi veţi fi culeşi unul câte unul, feciori ai lui Israel!

verses.geez: ወውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ይነፍሑ፡ በቀርን፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወይመጽኡ፡ እለ፡ ተሐጕሉ፡ በብሔረ፡ ፋርስ፡ ወተሐጕሉ፡ በግብጽ፡ ወይሰግዱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በደብረ፡ መቅደሱ፡ ዘኢየሩሳሌም።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that they shall blow the great trumpet, and the lost ones in the land of the Assyrians shall come, and the lost ones in Egypt, and shall worship the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass in that day, that they shall blow the great trumpet, and the lost ones in the land of the Assyrians shall come, and the lost ones in Egypt, and shall worship the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea, trâmbiţa cea mare va trâmbiţa şi cei care se pierduseră în pământul Asiriei şi cei ce se risipiseră în ţara Egiptului vor veni şi se vor închina Domnului, în muntele cel sfânt, în Ierusalim.
